findings.issue: הַשֹּׁהַם is a common noun with the article, not a proper name; "shóham" leaves that lemma untranslated.
The repeated פתח root (pual passive participle + plural construct noun) is split into "abiertas" and "grabados", so the cognate is not kept and the noun is resolved as engraving.
"de" between the hophal participle and מִשְׁבְּצֹת is grammatical smoothing; Hebrew juxtaposes them with no preposition.

notes: 3mp qal wayyiqtol, plural stones, settings of gold, seal, and names of the sons of Israel match the tokens.
